What We Do

What We Provides You

No Additional Fees

Flexible Payment Method

Pay After joining the company

About Us

Best guidance and support for all selection rounds, client rounds, assessments, and certifications.

Complete BGV support and onboarding guidance.

Process Duration: 03 to 45 days (depends on role and market).

Training [Only If candidate Needed or else we will Proceed for Direct Placement]

Currently we are ready to start "Java Backend Developer" Training.

Please connect with us for other Role/Technology/Skillset Training schedule plans.

Training Duration: 45 to 60 days [Flexible Timing plans].

Open to Freshers to 25 years of experience (IT Exp, Non-IT Exp, and Career Gaps).

Seamless Job Assistance with PAN India Opportunities

"Zenbyte Technologies provides no advance fees or hidden charges, offering transparent and flexible payment options. With roles spanning top MNCs and tailored training, we guide you to success in IT and beyond."

01 What are the payment terms for the placement process?

Payments are required only after receiving the confirmation letter or after joining the company.

02 Are there any registration or hidden fees involved in the process?

No, there are no registration fees, additional fees, or hidden charges.

03What kind of guidance and support does Zenbyte Technologies provide?

They offer guidance for all selection rounds, client rounds, assessments, certifications, complete BGV (Background Verification) support, and onboarding assistance.

04What is the typical duration for the placement process?

The process duration ranges from 3 to 45 days, depending on the role and market conditions.

05Is training offered as part of the placement process?

Yes, training is offered if the candidate needs it. Otherwise, the process can proceed directly.

06What training is currently available, and how long does it take?

Training for "Java Backend Developer" is currently available, with a duration of 45 to 60 days, featuring flexible timing options.

07What types of companies are part of the placement program?

The program includes leading MNCs and mid-level companies such as TCS, IBM, HCL, CTS, Wipro, and Hexaware.

08What roles or technologies are covered in the placement program?

Roles include Java Developer, Front-End/Back-End Developer, QA Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Data Scientist, Cloud Engineer, UX/UI Designer, and more.

09Are there any restrictions on educational qualifications for candidates?

No, candidates with any degree or graduation year are accepted, with no restrictions on educational qualifications or career gaps.

10What is the experience level of candidates eligible for the program?

The program is open to freshers as well as candidates with up to 25 years of experience, including IT and non-IT backgrounds and career gaps.

11Where are the placement opportunities available?

Placement opportunities are available PAN India, in cities like Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Coimbatore, Gurugram, Noida, Mumbai, Kolkata, and more.

12What salary can candidates expect?

The salaries offered are competitive and among the best in the industry.

Why Choose Us?

With our training and placement program, we ensure you’re not just prepared
but confident to succeed in your career.
Start your journey toward a rewarding technical job today!

JAVA Developer 100%

UX/UI Designer 90%

At Zenbyte Technologies we don't just train; we transform your career aspirations into reality. With our job-oriented training programs and placement support, you can confidently step into the world of technical excellence.

Zenbyte Placement Tracker

The Zenbyte Placement Tracker is an internal tool used to monitor candidate interview progress and job offer statuses.

How it works: Candidates authorize the application to securely connect to their email. The app strictly accesses email metadata (Subject and Sender fields) to scan for placement-related updates (e.g., "offer" or "selected").

Privacy focused: The application does not read, access, or store the body content of your emails. The data is used exclusively to update your placement status with our training team. For more details, please review our Privacy Policy.
